name: automation-workflows
description: Automation workflow skills for using OpenCLI to drive browsers, author adapters, and repair broken adapters.

interface.shortDescription: OpenCLI skills for browser and CLI automation workflows.
interface.longDescription: Automation Workflows packages the OpenCLI agent skills for Codex. It helps agents discover OpenCLI commands, drive logged-in Chrome sessions through opencli browser, create reusable site adapters, and repair broken adapters with trace-guided autofix workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use opencli-usage to find the right OpenCLI command for this task.
Use opencli-browser to drive this logged-in browser flow.
Use opencli-adapter-author to create and verify a new OpenCLI adapter.
